$comment: Every external source the teaching surfaces cite. Each entry carries the date it was last read, because a link that rotted is a citation nobody can check. tests/test_sources.py binds this list to the pages in both directions: a URL on a page that is not here fails, and an entry here that no page cites fails. The reachability check is a separate CI job, because a gate that needs the network cannot live in make check.

sources.title: Implementing SLOs
sources.publisher: Google, The Site Reliability Workbook, chapter 2
sources.supports: The definitions of indicator, objective and error budget, written as good events over valid events

sources.title: Alerting on SLOs
sources.publisher: Google, The Site Reliability Workbook, chapter 5
sources.supports: Burn rate, and multiwindow multi-burn-rate alerting as the approach it recommends over a raw threshold

sources.title: AI engineering for reliable operations
sources.supports: The five autonomy levels from manual to full, and the guardrails it names: no ambient access and least privilege, circuit breakers, dry run support, and safe-by-default actuation

sources.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications
sources.publisher: OWASP GenAI Security Project, published 9 December 2025
sources.supports: The named agentic risks this lab is exposed to: goal hijack, tool misuse, privilege abuse, memory and context poisoning, and human-agent trust exploitation

sources.title: Signals
sources.supports: Traces, metrics and logs as the signals the substrate is built from
